blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate impeachment court presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero unveiled on Friday the schedule for the rest of the trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. This, as the court temporarily adjourns to give way for the 2027 national budget debates, starting Monday, November 23. Escudero announced that the next trial days would be on December 1 to 4, 7, 9 to 11 and 14 to 16, as necessary. Initially, November 26 and 27 were also allotted for more defense witnesses to take the stand, but lead defense counsel Atty. Sheila Sison informed the court that none of their listed […]...
